name: @sagitta/runtime
description: 由 Sagitta Updater 加载的预设、提示词与业务插件

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && tsc -p plugins/memory/tsconfig.json && tsc -p plugins/task/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run build:shared && tsc -p plugins/memory/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p plugins/task/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:database: npm run build && node --test tests/database.test.js tests/task-repository.test.js
